texto: Your reputation led us to believe this endeavor would be a success, but we did not realize how successful it would be. We are already hearing news of DuraPaq's stock value depreciating in the wake of their losses. Feel free to enjoy the bonus we've included on your contract. I'm sure we'll look to you for any future "negotiations" we might have.

Defeating the local's hired guns has finally brought cooler heads among their population to the negotiating table.  While some now see selling their land as a better alternative to more fighting, others still refuse to relinquish their property.  The Tamarind board of directors now feel the best course of action is to work more directly with the populace.  We will still begin our mining operations here, but we will do our best to staff the facilities with surveyors and foremen from the local populace so that we may attempt to mine the minerals we seek with minimal disruption of the buried Star League facilities they hold so dear. 

You have fulfilled the letter of the contract and we have no further need of your services at this time. Your reputation continues to precede you. We will pass along our satisfaction to the Mercenary Review Board.
Know that you've earned the gratitude of two Great Houses. Representatives from both of our governments will be sure to leave favorable reports with the Mercenary Review Board.

Although you took the job for payment, know that on this day you advanced the cause of social justice against illogical and harmful biases against the physically challenged. We live in a time where bionics are a lifeline to a sense of normalcy for billions of people across the Inner Sphere. The narrow-minded views of such fanatics should never be allowed to take root and erode the very ideals of inclusivity we hold dear within the League.

You have saved the lives of those who risked everything to throw off the Archon's booted foot. You can be proud of having served the Free Skye movement. For your efforts, we would like to reward you with this intercepted shipment of NAIS Double Heat Sinks that House Davion intended to supply the Archon's Dogs with to further suppress the people of Isle.  We hope that you will use them to continue the fight so that the common man might one day be free of the tyrannical House Lords.
The traitors have been rounded up, and the stability of the Lyran Commonwealth has been fortified. You will be well rewarded for your service.
The Free Skye Movement thanks you for restoring peace to the Isle of Skye, and is covering your contracted payment in full.

Archon Katrina Steiner and the Lyran Commonwealth owe you their gratitude for your assistance in eradicating the Free Skye movement. Although the flame of independence never truly dies out in this region, your participation ensured that we will not see it burn bright again for quite some time. But when it does, we shall be ready to stamp it out again.

We understand your reservations for taking on this kind of work, but you accomplished a lot of good here. Those selfish buffoons you eliminated would have continued needlessly spilling Lyran blood in their foolish quests for personal glory. One death to save dozens, if not hundreds? The ledgers are easily balanced when you look at it that way.

titulo: A Dragon in Sheep's Clothing Pt. 3
texto:
FIELD COMMUNICATION: OMEGA SECURITY: FOR YOUR EYES ONLY

Your contract has been successfully executed. Your services have greatly benefited the Dragon. We hope you will accept future contracts and ride into battle alongside our nation's honorable warriors.

titulo: Shadow War: Order of the Five Pillars
texto:
INCOMING MESSAGE: FOR YOUR EYES ONLY

The reach of the Order of the Five Pillars extends throughout the whole of the Combine, and even into other realms. For your assistance in preserving the Dragon's peace, you will find prosperity and a welcome hand wherever you may go.

FIELD COMMUNICATION: OMEGA SECURITY: FOR YOUR EYES ONLY

Your continued loyalty to the ISF has shown us that not all mercenaries are motivated solely by money and hollow promises. You have more than earned your payment. We hope you will remain available for future services, should the Dragon have need of your excellence.
You have fulfilled the letter of the contract. Your reputation continues to precede you. We will pass along our satisfaction to the Mercenary Review Board.
In the past, the Combine's history with mercenaries has been murky, usually due to a lucrewarrior's total lack of honor or capability. Perhaps we may have misjudged some of them.

I know we will all lose sleep for months to come because of the many civilians who lost their lives. But we upheld the greater good this day. We have successfully secured the chemical weapons cache and will be working with the proper authorities in an effort to safely dispose of them.  Among the chemical weapons, we also found a number of 'Mech grade weapons in various states of disrepair.  We have no need of them so you are free to take them off our hands.

Never let it be said that your command lacks honor, Commander. You have done our people and the Lagom-gumi a valuable service. If you do not wish to risk your reputation by admitting having openly worked with yakuza, then list "Middle Way Ltd." on your résumé. Anyone searching for that organization will reach us, and we will gladly extol your virtues.

Go with peace and honor. May we cross paths again if the universe wills it.

You took a risk, Commander, but it looks like it paid off in spades—for both of us. Your salvage crews managed to dig up a pretty decent haul for me, including an operational ’Mech chassis. None of my clients are in the market for scout ’Mechs, so consider it part of your payment. It'll probably do your unit more good than it will me.

There are no words to express our thanks. We know you're only in this for the money, but we'd like to believe there’s some goodness in you as well. We don’t have much, but as a demonstration of our gratitude, we’d like to present to you this ancient BattleMech that's been in our family for generations. It's not doing us any good just sitting here rusting away, so consider it yours. It’s old and doesn't work quite right, but something tells me you’ll find a way to put it to good use.

Well, Commander, the job is done, and the end results are all that matter. Our salvage crews discovered some surplus heat sinks, jump jets, and a lucky stash of damaged lostech weapons among the wreckage that's all yours for the taking. You might not've enjoyed this job from a moral standpoint, but this ancient Star League hardware should more than compensate for those qualms. You're new at this, so we will offer you some free advice: remind yourself that everyone is simply trying to survive—you, me, the weak, the strong. The Inner Sphere is a hard place, and sometimes you will need to get your hands dirty to stay alive.

Commander, you may feel like a small, insignificant figure under the shadow of the mighty Davion war machine, but rest assured, your role was critical in aiding our invasion. As a show of gratitude for answering our call to arms, we wish to gift you with this 'Mech salvaged from the Kuritan front lines. Take your pay, and know you bolstered the Federated Suns in bringing freedom to those in need.

Arigato Commander for answering our call for assistance. Despite being a warrior without a master, you have shown commendable loyalty and honor in coming to our aid. When Davion forces attacked, a MechWarrior within my command abandoned his duties, and with it, his claim to his family's BattleMech. In honor of answering the Combine's call to arms, I gift it to you. Along with our finest pieces of salvage from the Davion invaders.

May it serve you well.

Just heard back from our employers. The syndicate has agreed to conduct ongoing negotiations with the miners thanks to your efforts.

The payout we got will help offset some of our costs as well. All around, I’d call that a good days work, Commander. Nice job.
We would offer our thanks, but we cannot condone your honorless conduct, despite your actions greatly helping our war effort. Take your pay and be gone.

You have proven yourself capable of making smart choices and carrying through on your promises. Rest easy knowing that you have shielded the freedom of the Federated Suns. If you wish to continue following this righteous path, remember that employment opportunities with House Davion will always be available to you.

A job well done. The loss of such a prominent member of Kuritan command is sure to throw a wrench in the Coordinator's invasion plans. Accept our payment knowing that you have fulfilled your part in defending our realm.
Arigato gozaimasu Commander. Please take these weapons of war as a token of our gratitude, and may they serve you well in future battles.

The defector and their associates are dead, put down like mongrels. Without honor, they are worse than ronin. Their dishonor will be a stain on their descendants for generations to come. You are welcome to their supply of surplus Davion goods. The Draconis Combine has no need for such filth.

To be honest, we didn’t expect this decoy plan to work, but you played your part perfectly and made it out in once piece. We saw no pirate activity while the convoy was underway, and we suspect that was in large part due to your distraction tactics.

Thank you for a job well done, but between us, I’d recommend you find a different line of work. There has to be a safer way to make a living.

—COMMS SYSTEM ERROR: Message ID not found

—COMMS SYSTEM ERROR: Sender ID not found

New Messages 1:

Ceres Metals Industries would like to thank you for your purchase of our venerable VND-1R BattleMech. The pride of the CCAF for over 190 years! This message is to inform you that as requested, your new BattleMech has been delivered to the Bethel system.  Please scan your credentials at the system's jump point and our fulfillment agents will assist in transferring your new BattleMech into your provided MechBay.

Thank you for choosing Ceres Metals for all your BattleMech needs!

It appears your elimination of the “man of the people” was a severe blow to their morale. The citizens of my duchy seem to have simmered down, either beaten into submission or given a healthy dose of reality. Either way, I need not worry about them for the moment. Thank you for your service to me, and ultimately to the Celestial Wisdom, may he live forever.

Thank you for your efforts in defending our honored citizens. Even though the Cerberus Hounds' ancestors were not Capellans by birth, the Hounds themselves stand as a testament to the Capellan ideal that everybody has a right to earn citizenship in this great nation. We thank you for preserving our people and, most importantly, our valuable military assets.

Your continued success on the battlefield has not gone unseen by Duke Hasek-Davion. For your valiant service to the Capellan March, he would like to extend you a gift of ancient Star League Defense Force Autocannons from his personal collection.  Duke Hasek-Davion much prefers to see such weapons in the hands of those defending the Capellan March than those who would see them shipped out to the New Avalon Institute of Science for study.

The Celestial Wisdom will long remember your service this day. The Confederation makes a point of rewarding such services in the name of the state. And as such, House Liao would like to extend your command this Davion BattleMech trophy as a gift on behalf of Chancellor Liao. The fed rat that previously possessed it will have no further need of it. May it serve you and the Capellan State for generations to come.  The Chancellor may call on you again, should your services be needed in the future.

Thank you for what you’ve done for me. I know you simply accepted the contract, but I owe you a life debt for saving my son from a terrible fate. 

In order to pay off his life debt, he would like to humbly offer his services as a pilot.

The invaders have been dealt with, and thanks to your timely assistance, their planned raid will never take place. Our salvage teams have discovered that a number of their 'Mechs have been outfitted with what appears to be lostech equipment bearing the markings of NAIS prototypes.  It appears that the NAIS has been attempting to rediscover how to manufacture ancient Star League lost technology. With this raid being orchestrated as an effort to field test this equipment.

For your commendable services to the Capellan State, you are free to take a few of these Prototypes as your combat pay bonus, but we must deliver all remaining samples back to Sian for study. Your contributions to the safety and security of the Capellan Confederation have been noted.

titulo: The Enemy of My Enemy Pt. 3
texto:
Further evidence gathered by SAFE indicates that House Davion may indeed have been behind the Lexington Combat Group's initial hiring, and MIIO and MI6 counterintelligence agents had led us to implicate one of our own regiments, thus weakening our defense in case of potential Capellan incursions. Although the Federated Suns is too distant for us to strike back over this duplicity, this treachery will be remembered.

We thank you for your part in helping us prevent open war.  Feel free to take this salvaged Oriente BattleMech as a bonus on behalf of SAFE. But remember: none of this ever happened. You are bound by the Free Worlds League's Official Secrets Act and the nondisclosure clause within your contract. Should you breach that provision of your contract in the slightest, ComStar's Mercenary Review Board is obligated to consider your mercenary license null and void; all of your assets will be seized, and your entire command will face prison time. I trust we understand each other in this delicate matter?

Logbooks and journals found among the ruins of the pirates' bases paint a grim tale of what transpired after my son's ship mis-jumped. The jump stranded them here, with no means of outside contact, so they settled with hopes of making the best of things. My son, as a trained diplomat and former Free Worlds soldier, quickly took charge of the survivors. However, isolation and dwindling supplies caused them all to turn on each other, but it was an insidious, nonlethal toxin in the water table that drove them to even higher levels of paranoia and violence—a state they called "the Reckoning." When a ship passing through the system noticed signs of habitation and sent a DropShip to investigate, my son and his fellow survivors, driven by the toxin's altered state, attacked the crew and took command of their ship, ultimately using it to begin their reign of piracy and terror in this region using stolen weapons of war. Including what appears to be lost technology from the Star League era. But no matter how far they ventured, Ravid's pirates always returned to this planet: their bodies had become so used to the toxin in the water that going extended periods of time without it sickened them.

My son's death was…an unfortunate circumstance from all of this tragedy, but at least now I know what became of him. I can now finally put his memory to rest.

You've put a stop to Quickscell's corporate machinations...at least for now. Quickscell, like most powerful transnational corporations, is far too insulated to be completely run out of business within the Free Worlds League borders. However, Parliament will ensure the company is hit with hefty fines, and Quickscell's leadership will be censured. Those penalties will cow them for the next decade, if not longer.

As one final act of defiance before I officially resign, I submitted forged delivery papers for our next shipment from our factories to be delivered directly to your dropship.  Feel free to ignore the final destination and enjoy your bonus on behalf of my former employers.

—INCOMING MESSAGE—

Sender: UNKNOWN

You have done our people an invaluable service. We trust that you will continue to help the downtrodden speak up and be heard. Please accept this BattleMech as a token of appreciation for your services and your silence on this matter.

MESSAGE FROM COUNT CAMERON-JONES:

Commander, you have carried the day and helped me purge the unworthy from the ranks, until only those truly loyal to Regulus remain. Know that those few who survived your guns will face court-martial and the fullest extent of military law for their ignoble actions.

The Principality of Regulus shall long remember your contribution to this matter of provincial security.

To be honest, we didn’t expect this decoy plan to work, but you played your part perfectly and made it out in once piece. We saw no pirate activity while the convoy was underway, and we suspect that was in large part due to your distraction tactics.

Commander, I would like to thank you for locating my father’s 'Mech. I know he would have been happy to know his wish was fulfilled. In regards to my brother Bowen, I’m... 

I'm sad to see that this is how his story ended. We were somewhat close when I was young, but our family's fall from grace lead him down a dark path, much like my father after he was discharged from the Free Worlds Guards.  But unlike my father, Bowen never found someone like Nikolai Mason to give him a second chance at life. All he found was more bitterness and resentment eating away at him like a cancer.  I wished he found someone that gave him the will to move on with his life like your father gave mine.  Perhaps then we could have had a chance to reminisce on the good things that we miss about him rather than the bad...

I... I should let you go... Take good care of Agincourt for my father, Commander. He’ll be watching.

Good work Commander. I don't believe Jake Kalimar's group would have survived that assault if it had been anyone else there. With their hold discovered, Jake Kalimar has reached out to IE for assistance in relocating their families and hold to a safer location before the Confederation sends a larger force in to destroy them. We will help relocate and establish a new base of operations closer towards IE's own holdings within the region in exchange for their protection detail.

Yaros said that you performed commendably and wants to provide you with a Corsair salvaged from the enemy commander as a combat bonus for ensuring that they all live to see another day.

To the mercenary Commander, thank you for all your help in dealing with the Crimson Inclination. Their little rebellion has been wiped off the map. Brigadier General Rouzurski recommended that we reward you with Fransson's 'Mech, and we agree that it would be a suitable bonus for your excellent performance. The whole system thanks you, Commander. We are eternally grateful and your contributions will not be forgotten.

You have our thanks, mercenary.

Because of you, news of Stanz's militia has been mostly repressed, and a national embarrassment has been avoided. And of course, millions of lives have been saved.

Please accept our payment, but more importantly, another special reward that we managed to excavate from the wreckage. We figure you may have more use for Stanz's King Crab than we would.

It is finally done. The mad heretic and all of the weak-minded followers she told lies to are dead, all thanks to you. The church does not wish to see Windery's delusional crusade martyr her or her forsaken cause. As such, as a token of our true leader’s gratitude and generosity, you are free to take the heretic's 'Mech with you.

But listen carefully Commander. Despite our sincere gratitude for your handling of our sensitive issue, you and your staff are the only souls who knows of us without being brought into the fold. If you dare speak our name or allude to any church secrets you may or may not have encountered while under our employ in any corner of the galaxy before our grand reveal, the Church Of Kali will find you and prop up your corpse right beside Whidbey’s.

For we have pledged our loyalty to the one true avatar of Kali. And her return is near. Our leader has seen her in her minds eye. Has seen the white tiger. Has seen the rakshasa. And has seen that once united, the galaxy will burn. Cleansing all of the non-believers. 

When that day comes, I pray that you will stand with us again, Commander. We will be sure to make your loyalty worth your while.

Commander,

The Ministry of Information, Intelligence, and Operations has examined the contract, crew testimonies, and transmissions you've shared with the man you knew as Silvan Vaughn. After a thorough review of your provided intel, the MIIO have cleared you and your mercenary company of all wrong doing. I am here to debrief you on this matter.

The man you knew as Silvan Vaughn was a ghost. The MIIO had no information on him or his motives pior to your techs pulling his carcass out of his 'Mech's cockpit and handing his body over to us. And the information he shared with you about candidate Owens was misleading to say the least. It is true and well known throughout the Capellan March that Casper Owens is an outspoken critic of Duke Hasek-Davion. But what Vaughn didn't tell you is that Owens is also a staunch international trade hawk running on a platform of pushing heavy tariffs on interstellar imports from the Capellan Confederation as his primary running issue. Our ongoing theory is that House Liao did not take too kindly to this and dispatched Maskirovka agents to kill Owens. When the Syrtis Fusiliers guarding the candidate proved to be too much for them on their initial attempt to take Owens out and put them on the run, they hired you to guard them and disrupt the Fusiliers enough to provide them with another window to make a second attempt on Owens' life.

While it was your transgressions against the Syrtis Fusiliers that gave Vaughn his best window to complete his mission, had it not been for your actions on Novaya Zemlya coming to Owens' defense and destroying Vaughns' strike team, I doubt Owens would be here today. Due to your impromptu assistance in defending Owens' life, the AFFS and the MIIO have agreed to drop all charges against you and honor the payout and salvage rights of your MRB backed contract. You have a grateful President Elect Owens to thank for our generosity on this matter. I would advise that in the future you pay closer attention to who your merc company gets into bed with. The AFFS and the MIIO will not be so lenient if you are ever caught pulling a stunt like this again. Now, take your C-bills and your salvage and then get the hell out of my system.

Thank you, Commander, your aid has been absolutely critical in piecing together and stopping Henrik's plot to unseat my family. With Henrik killed, the Draconis Combine no longer have a convenient puppet in their pocket to lay a claim to the Raman system. While I doubt those snakes will give up their aspirations to conquer our land to expand the Combine's border, Henrik's death makes it clear that House Cole will never make it easy for them!

We've taken a copy of Henrik's 'Mech's data core and will be giving it over to the Federation's Ministry of Information, Intelligence, and Operations. With any luck, Director Quintus Allard will be able to extract more info from it that might help prevent a future attack. As to the 'Mech itself, please keep it on behalf of House Cole, in addition to your negotiated payment. 

House Cole cannot keep it, as it is evidence of our raid into Combine space. Such a unique 'Mech would be impossible to hide, and we cannot risk word getting back to the Combine that we were involved with an attack on one of their systems. So it is all yours.

Safe travels, Commander.

Good work, the Steiner General is dead, and the secret is kept safe. I've received payment from my client, and I am wiring your cut. I will say, I'm quite surprised at their motives. I've had plenty of clients pay for Mercenaries to act as catalysts for conflict, but never have I seen someone pay to keep the fragile peace. I wonder who this shadow organization is, and if we'll ever hear from them again...

It was a pleasure working with you.

Client told us there would be a lance of local militia 'Mechs at most. 

Nope. It was an entire company from the Galedon Rangers.   

We blew the warehouse, but the rest of the crew were KIA when the Dracs surrounded us.  Me and Kobold barely made it out of there.  But then get this. Despite doing what we were paid to do, the Client had the gall to tell me that their contract was with Daron's Demons, not me. Said I was SOL and refused to pay up.

So I kinda need a favor. I spent the last of my scratch trackin' ya down and getting me and Kobold out here.  So I was hoping that I could bunk up with you and your unit for a stretch.  You know Kobold and I have the skillz to hold our own and make some C-billz together.

Whaddaya say?

Logbooks and journals found among the ruins of the pirates' bases paint a grim tale of what transpired after my son's ship mis-jumped. The jump stranded them here, with no means of outside contact, so they settled with hopes of making the best of things. My son, as a trained diplomat and former Free Worlds soldier, quickly took charge of the survivors. However, isolation and dwindling supplies caused them all to turn on each other, but it was an insidious, nonlethal toxin in the water table that drove them to even higher levels of paranoia and violence—a state they called "the Reckoning." When a ship passing through the system noticed signs of habitation and sent a DropShip to investigate, my son and his fellow survivors, driven by the toxin's altered state, attacked the crew and took command of their ship, ultimately using it to begin their reign of piracy and terror in this region using stolen weapons of war. Including what appears to be lost technology from the Star League era. But no matter how far they ventured, Ravid's pirates always returned to this planet: their bodies had become so used to the toxin in the water that going extended periods of time without it sickened them.

My son's death was…an unfortunate circumstance from all of this tragedy, but at least now I know what became of him. I can now finally put his memory to rest.

Although you took the job for payment, know that on this day you advanced the cause of social justice against illogical and harmful biases against the physically challenged. We live in a time where bionics are a lifeline to a sense of normalcy for billions of people across the Inner Sphere. The narrow-minded views of such fanatics should never be allowed to take root and erode the very ideals of inclusivity we hold dear within the League.

MESSAGE FROM COUNT CAMERON-JONES:

Commander, you have carried the day and helped me purge the unworthy from the ranks, until only those truly loyal to Regulus remain. Know that those few who survived your guns will face court-martial and the fullest extent of military law for their ignoble actions.

The Principality of Regulus shall long remember your contribution to this matter of provincial security.

You've put a stop to Quickscell's corporate machinations...at least for now. Quickscell, like most powerful transnational corporations, is far too insulated to be completely run out of business within the Free Worlds League borders. However, Parliament will ensure the company is hit with hefty fines, and Quickscell's leadership will be censured. Those penalties will cow them for the next decade, if not longer.

As one final act of defiance before I officially resign, I submitted forged delivery papers for our next shipment from our factories to be delivered directly to your dropship.  Feel free to ignore the final destination and enjoy your bonus on behalf of my former employers.

—INCOMING MESSAGE—

Sender: UNKNOWN

You have done our people an invaluable service. We trust that you will continue to help the downtrodden speak up and be heard. Please accept this BattleMech as a token of appreciation for your services and your silence on this matter.

titulo: A Dragon in Sheep's Clothing Pt. 3
texto:
FIELD COMMUNICATION: OMEGA SECURITY: FOR YOUR EYES ONLY

Your contract has been successfully executed. Your services have greatly benefited the Dragon. We hope you will accept future contracts and ride into battle alongside our nation's honorable warriors.

titulo: The Enemy of My Enemy Pt. 3
texto:
Further evidence gathered by SAFE indicates that House Davion may indeed have been behind the Lexington Combat Group's initial hiring, and MIIO and MI6 counterintelligence agents had led us to implicate one of our own regiments, thus weakening our defense in case of potential Capellan incursions. Although the Federated Suns is too distant for us to strike back over this duplicity, this treachery will be remembered.

We thank you for your part in helping us prevent open war.  Feel free to take this salvaged Oriente BattleMech as a bonus on behalf of SAFE. But remember: none of this ever happened. You are bound by the Free Worlds League's Official Secrets Act and the nondisclosure clause within your contract. Should you breach that provision of your contract in the slightest, ComStar's Mercenary Review Board is obligated to consider your mercenary license null and void; all of your assets will be seized, and your entire command will face prison time. I trust we understand each other in this delicate matter?
Know that you've earned the gratitude of two Great Houses. Representatives from both of our governments will be sure to leave favorable reports with the Mercenary Review Board.

Defeating the local's hired guns has finally brought cooler heads among their population to the negotiating table.  While some now see selling their land as a better alternative to more fighting, others still refuse to relinquish their property.  The Tamarind board of directors now feel the best course of action is to work more directly with the populace.  We will still begin our mining operations here, but we will do our best to staff the facilities with surveyors and foremen from the local populace so that we may attempt to mine the minerals we seek with minimal disruption of the buried Star League facilities they hold so dear. 

You have fulfilled the letter of the contract and we have no further need of your services at this time. Your reputation continues to precede you. We will pass along our satisfaction to the Mercenary Review Board.

Thank you for what you’ve done for me. I know you simply accepted the contract, but I owe you a life debt for saving my son from a terrible fate. 

In order to pay off his life debt, he would like to humbly offer his services as a pilot.

Your reputation led us to believe this endeavor would be a success, but we did not realize how successful it would be. We are already hearing news of DuraPaq's stock value depreciating in the wake of their losses. Feel free to enjoy the bonus we've included on your contract. I'm sure we'll look to you for any future "negotiations" we might have.

titulo: A Dragon in Sheep's Clothing Pt. 3
texto:
FIELD COMMUNICATION: OMEGA SECURITY: FOR YOUR EYES ONLY

Your contract has been successfully executed. Your services have greatly benefited the Dragon. We hope you will accept future contracts and ride into battle alongside our nation's honorable warriors.

We understand your reservations for taking on this kind of work, but you accomplished a lot of good here. Those selfish buffoons you eliminated would have continued needlessly spilling Lyran blood in their foolish quests for personal glory. One death to save dozens, if not hundreds? The ledgers are easily balanced when you look at it that way.

You have saved the lives of those who risked everything to throw off the Archon's booted foot. You can be proud of having served the Free Skye movement. For your efforts, we would like to reward you with this intercepted shipment of NAIS Double Heat Sinks that House Davion intended to supply the Archon's Dogs with to further suppress the people of Isle.  We hope that you will use them to continue the fight so that the common man might one day be free of the tyrannical House Lords.
The traitors have been rounded up, and the stability of the Lyran Commonwealth has been fortified. You will be well rewarded for your service.
The Free Skye Movement thanks you for restoring peace to the Isle of Skye, and is covering your contracted payment in full.

Archon Katrina Steiner and the Lyran Commonwealth owe you their gratitude for your assistance in eradicating the Free Skye movement. Although the flame of independence never truly dies out in this region, your participation ensured that we will not see it burn bright again for quite some time. But when it does, we shall be ready to stamp it out again.

Well Commander, despite our best efforts, it appears that the Twentieth Skye Rangers remain unfazed. Even after the countless attacks, slaughter, and destruction, it seems that the remaining players on the team are resolute in participating. As a matter of fact, it appears that the hardships have only bolstered their resolve, and support for the team is at an all-time high.

This is where we part ways. Please accept your payment in full, and know that you have satisfied us with your performance. As for us, it's time to get back to the drawing board and examine if we have alternative ways to beat this team.

Hello, Mercenary. It seems there have been some, unfortunate, catastrophic intelligence errors made.  While we were examining the diagnostics of the stolen 'Mechs, and cross referencing some of the prior security data, it seems that the “operatives,” were merely a relatively minor criminal gang operating under the leadership of one Pete “Willy-Pete” Williams (Who is currently being washed out of the cockpit of one of the 'Mechs you just recently destroyed). It seems that Williams and his gang simply wanted to steal a 'Mech for, ah… fun, and were not actually under anyone’s actual employ, least of all, TharHes.  Those facilities you leveled, were similarly, not affiliated with TharHes in any way. He had simply been employed at those locations in the recent past as a sanitary technician before he began his life of crime. Those industrial sites were for the most part, actual legitimate businesses, with the exception of Mr. William’s gang holdings. The Bowie Electronics board of Directors is deeply embarrassed by this, and would appreciate your continued silence on this unfortunate matter, as well as the full deletion of any and all of our correspondence regarding this operation. Though Bowie Electronics is grateful for your help in all this, they would ask you to please leave the system before any investigations start.

You have our deepest gratitude, Mercenary.

The facility mostly escaped destruction and should be operational again shortly due to your intervention.

Good work, Commander.

We've confirmed that the El Giza Ghost Rider leadership is dead, and any remaining mercenaries have disbanded. It seems that since they have failed to provide sufficient tribute to the Marian Hegemony Imperator, the offer for refuge has been withdrawn. The surviving Ghost Riders will likely be hunted by whatever they were running from. Nevertheless, it's not our concern.

Thank you mercenary. 

Because of your actions, we were able to crush this band of pirates but, most importantly, we avoided an unnecessary and surely brutal conflict with Davion forces. We've sent along your pay, as well as a glowing commendation to the Mercenary Review Board.

Excellent work, Commander. My brother has formally declared his surrender. After his little tantrum, he's been remanded to house arrest in his villa for the rest of my days. Despite him being a traitorous little weasel, he is still my brother. I've given permission to Archon Steiner to do with him as she wishes when I die. Knowing that his only remaining life choices are to live out his luxurious life in solitude, or in a prison cell awaiting his execution, should keep him in line. As I can never see him willingly trading away his fine silk sheets for any "lesser" accommodations.

In any case, thank you, Commander for bringing this unfortunate business to an end. I've provided you with an extra bonus for your company's discretion in these delicate matters of state. I hope that I may rely on your services again in the future, if I have any need for them again.

We thank you for your assistance in protecting some of the Dragon's most closely-guarded secrets. Please accept this payment for your good work, but be reminded that you are bound to a plethora of non-disclosure gag orders. If anyone gets word of our work, you'll be sure that the Draconis Combine will come for you, too.

This is a tragic day for free enterprise. The Obsidian Harvest Corporation, a well-respected resource extraction company has been all but destroyed by a marauding mercenary band. This is a somber day for every star system that rests loyal under the proud flag of House Marik.

Your payment has been delivered, alongside your non-disclosure agreement.

titulo: The Only Truth That Sticks Pt.3
texto: Excellent work, Commander. This humiliating defeat for Candace is a blemish on the St. Ives Compact and her rule. She will learn that the Confederation will never forgive her or the people of St. Ives for abandoning the Capellan State. Hopefully the shame of her loss will begin to stir dissent within the Compact, and will drive them back to the Capellan Confederation, where they rightfully belong.

After negotiating with our ambassador to the Draconis Combine, House Kurita have put forward terms in which the ronin may surrender to our forces without dishonoring the Combine's warrior code of bushido. With Takeda dead, and his lieutenants eliminated, the remaining samurai are to swear fealty to the Coordinator and follow his wishes of returning home to serve the Combine once more. The remaining ronin have agreed to these terms have surrendered to our forces.

While we here in the Republic are furious that this arrangement will see these war criminals return home with barely a slap on the wrist, the Republic cannot continue to tolerate a protracted guerilla war. If returning a handful of low-level samurai to the Dragon is the cost of peace and security in our realm for the first time in its history, it's a price that Elected Prince Magnusson is willing to pay. A Draconis Combine rep has officially signed their terms of surrender, and the remaining troops are vacating our space as we speak.

We are grateful for your assistance in this matter, Commander. While the Republic still mistrusts mercenaries after everything they did in the Ronin Wars, your company has showed tremendous compassion for the people of Rasalhague. I hope that should my government find itself in need of mercenaries again, they call on you once more.

Excellent work Commander!  

Not only were you able to acquire surplus supplies in excess of what we initially estimated, but you've also eliminated more of the Arcturan Guard's Hatchetmen for us to salvage.  With this surplus, my superiors have authorized me to provide you with our first refurbished Hatchetman as a bonus for your exemplary performance. You'll need it for your next assignment.

Great work Commander, 

In addition to destroying the Arcturan Guard's data-center, we've discovered that the Guards appear to have been using their stockpile of Hatchetman to experiment with refitting a number of their other 'Mechs with similar Melee weapons.  

While it appears that these alternative melee weapons are nothing more than cosmetic knock-offs of the hatchet technology developed by Defiance, they each seem to have different offensive profiles when compared to the standard hatchet.

As a performance bonus, we'll provide you with a few samples of the weapons we salvaged from the facility. These weapons appear to be compatible with the Hatchetman we've provided you so we hope you can put them to good use.

Commander, 

We can't thank you enough for giving the patriots of Skye the means to defend our own borders.  You've done more to support our people than our own head of state.  While Archon Steiner squanders her time placating the Commonwealth's oligarchs and getting in bed with foreign Davion pigs and warmongers, the people of Skye suffer under the relentless raids of House Kurita. 
Thanks to your efforts, we now stand a chance at standing up to these foreign hoards and, maybe one day, freeing ourselves from this ridiculous FedCom alliance the Archon has forced upon us.

If we find ourselves needing your services again we won't hesitate to call.

Commander,

I just confirmed with Spears that we've received our full payout. We definitely earned this one. I'm not gonna lie, when we had Jade Falcon WarShips seconds away from firing on us, I thought we'd finally bitten off more than we could chew. But you pushed beyond your limits and pulled us through the muck, Commander. Your father would have been proud.

He also said Kommandant Steiner gave your performance a glowing review, so we have another satisfied customer. Not a bad outcome, considering the two of you were at each other's throats. Thankfully, you boys seemed to bury the hatchet - and a few Jade Falcons so we could pull through.

According to Spears, Kommandant Steiner has risen in the ranks thanks to the success of this operation. Apparently, Regent Katherine Steiner-Davion was following his exploits closely. So we helped him look good.

But now that Steiner's orbiting the throne, Spears says one of his mercenaries, Valten Ryder and his Bushwacker 'Mech, is looking for a change of scenery. I reckon we can never have enough veteran MechWarriors who know how to fight.

Before Spears departed for IE, he informed me that, now armed with new intel, it likely won't be long before they come calling again. But I think we should sit back and wait for a job offer that will be far less taxing. Preferably outside of the Clan occupation zone. I think we've had our fill of those demons.  

I'll let you know if anything comes through the pipeline.

Jake,

I just confirmed that all supplies were recovered from the ground.

Intel shows the Steel Vipers are backing off. Looks like they might be packing up and leaving after all... So our stone connected with both birds in this case.

So far, you've been able to help minimize risk, and boosted IE's resources. Not bad. Hiring you for a job is never bad idea. 

We need to refuel the JumpShip for the long journey. Our navigators are estimating the length of this burn to Cambridge as we speak. I'll let you know when I have an update and we're ready to depart.
It felt good to carve another loss onto Redmond's combat record, but she still hasn't conceded the trial to us. We're not leaving this battlefield until she admits defeat. Let's make it happen!

Commander,

Good news, the surviving members of the Third Republican forces has surrendered. So the Hussars I lost did not die in vain. But the Marik Commanders just informed me that another force has joined the fray. The Van Diemen Militia has declared they will attack. It seems the ferocious pace of Operation Guerrero kept them on the bench, but they're about to dive into the game with both feet. I’ll let you know what this means for you shortly.

Commander,

It looks like you accomplished what we asked you to do. You helped dislodge the Kuritans in this sector of the Thumb. Currently, no other units have been dispatched to re-take it. We have also cut into another transmission. They speculate that the Lyran Alliance might be behind this operation, but they can’t confirm it at this point. I’m not sure they will be offering you any contracts anytime soon, though. Time will tell whether this has caused Theodore Kurita to rethink his plan to annex Lyon’s Thumb, but we have given them something to think about.

You’ve followed through on every term of the agreement. So you’re free to go. But before you do, your outfit will be transferred a special bonus on top of your negotiated payout. The Archon was pleased when she was briefed on the success of your operation here, so she asked me to ensure you were rewarded.

Thank you for your service, Commander. We’ll certainly consider you for future job offers after this performance.  Be safe out there.
Now that this initial combat test is complete, our engineers are evaluating the results. I will contact you when the evaluation process is concluded and we've decided how to move forward.

Commander,

Every Sunder ‘Mech is accounted for. We were facing a ton of risk and pressure down there, but thanks to you we were able to overcome it and give our engineers at our LAW factories a plethora of useful live-combat data to work with. If this test is any indication, we will be able to offer up plenty of pushback against the clans once the truce expires.

I know it wasn’t easy fighting against the Clanners in your old heap. It’s very impressive that you’ve been able to endure so many fights against the clans in your antique. We would like to update your gear. Since you helped test our Sunder and gave us a better idea of the improvements we need before we roll this out in earnest, we figured we’d gift you one as a thank you.

We’ll be in touch with instructions on how to accept delivery. Hopefully, it helps you stay profitable in the mercenary game a little while longer.

Well, the pirates know we’re here now. They’re threatening to inflict some civilian casualties if we don’t let them leave the system. But I’m not interested in letting them walk. They’ll just hibernate and return to cause more headaches. I’m sending you to deal with the rest of this filthy rabble before they add more victims to their reign of terror.

Good work, Commander. I’ve gotten reports that the Lyran Guards are not attempting to retake the mining site. That means that the citizens of the region that rely on it for their livelihood are free to do so again. Unfortunately, there is still work to be done here. There are still Lyrans hanging around in different sectors that need to be dealt with. And we have detected a Davion presence that has been causing similar problems. They will be dealt with in time.

But your work here is done; we will take it from here. Thank you for helping us bring hope to the people of New Home; they have longed for some light at the end of a very dark tunnel, and you have helped provide it. In recognition of your hard work, we have provided you with a performance bonus as a token of our appreciation.

We wish you well in your future endeavours, Commander.
